item.content:encoded:
+1 for the gripping, emotion jerking responsibility of Theta's new Commander to reconcile the parent of those dead. He coldly and regretfully responds to the situation of writing another man's death notice to be given to his mother. Calculated responses and fantastic contrast with the real reasoning and the false: sure is a good thing he wasn't taken by some anomaly and instead was killed through a weapon made by another man in the field of modern combat. The only message left to comfort is he died for the good of our nation's Strategic Consulting Partners.

All in all I liked it a lot, reminds me of that seen in Saving Private Ryan when the office's staff realized three of the four children of Mrs. Ryan were confirmed deceased around the same time. Chilling and cold.
